Expose supported recovered field evidence and exact paired/side-by-side comparison through attached result Refs, preserving original failed/interrupted Run state and old reader/promotion refusals. Runs uses the real extension verifier; the field owner supplies authoritative preprocessing/output policies to scalar comparison and refuses field contract/geometry/gauge drift. SDK comparison delegates to the selected sealed public CLI and never computes, recovers or promotes.

Clients correlate exact Ref/catalog/producer plus requested checkpoint/member/field/axis/index and comparison-side identities. Readers recheck current authority before disclosure, including revocation during segment capture. Additive status/2 exposes the actual stable actor/key/hash for cross-interface continuation reconciliation; status/1 and115 prior complete contracts remain unchanged.

Independent synthetic qualification branch b6a2ccb is preserved by a normal merge. Actual combined subject904922c/driver in retained receipt passed117.976s: fresh verified20,804-file/896,562,621-byte CPU capture; real completed/drained serialization child; copy fault; cold same-Run recovery; real semantic source/destination/readers; selected HTTP field access/comparison/foreign evaluation refusal; sealed CLI SDK comparison. Existing Run/grant/consumption/reservation, settled charges and events stay unchanged. Own temporary catalog/schema/root cleanup is confirmed. Explicitly synthetic serialization: no training, numerical producer/oracle or science acceptance.

Review found displaced typed-target decorator and missing exact selector correlation; subsequent subject415f5e1 fixes both with independent4-case positive/negative proof. Root affected owner/full-contract group28 passed3.469s, zero skips. The actual117.976s run belongs to904922c, not the later fix. Additive status/2 actualPGHTTP/old-projection/forged-key/full-contract group3 passed9.618s. Reviewed core/evidence source is clear; final small status/2 source review and hosted exact-head CI remain pending.

Draft based on PR97. Existing Run-panel UI is active in a separate dependent worktree. Browser/lineage, indexed diagnostics and full M1–M6 acceptance remain open; no CUDA, real-lab or new numerical-improvement claim. Historical source receipts and limits are retained under reports/m1-publication-evidence and reports/m1-publication-synthetic.



Hosted lifecycle39320650281/job118293498592 atd07e928 failed the project browser after catalog reload: the harness selected an asynchronously absent project option, emptying the select and entering Fixture Runs. This is distinct from PR99 native cleanup. A controlled real project-list-response hold reproduced that exact absent-option condition (red). Sourceeb2ebe5 changes only the browser helper to await enabled rendered options and the dataset handler; it adds that held-response regression without weakening project/link/reload/noexecution assertions. Independent review is clear, and the whole real readonly project browser passed at exacteb2 with PG17/Chromium151. Original hosted failure, red/green and browser receipts are in reports/m1-publication-evidence/ci-project-browser-repair/validation.json. Fresh corrected exact-head hosted checks and dependent/postmerge qualification remain pending.
